snapshot: WHO European Region. Positions itself as a middle power that steps forward in global health, with a Global Health Strategy for 2025 to 2030 and a focus on primary care and on cooperation with Latin America.

agenda.title: Europe-Latin America primary care alliance
agenda.text: At the World Health Assembly on 18 May 2026 Minister García said Europe and Latin America and the Caribbean showed readiness to build a partnership on primary health care. Spain sponsored the high-level meeting with PAHO and WHO Europe; a possible permanent mechanism for knowledge exchange was explored. It is not a signed agreement.

agenda.title: Hantavirus on the MV Hondius
agenda.text: In May 2026 Spain received passengers of the cruise ship MV Hondius in Tenerife after a hantavirus outbreak; the ship then continued to Rotterdam. Prime Minister Sánchez told the Assembly Spain evacuated more than 120 people and detected cases early, and called it a step forward. He said Spain cannot offset cuts to the international health system alone, criticised US cuts to global health aid, and said Spain has raised its development aid contributions.

agenda.title: Spanish Global Health Strategy 2025-2030
agenda.text: The government promoted its new Global Health Strategy for 2025 to 2030 in May 2025.
